description: Help someone take the first steps to starting a business with AI by turning their idea into a short business brief. Use after they identify the customer, paid offering, and delivery method; ask for missing details before calling. Accept an optional chosen business name. Returns the complete brief, a link that prefills Baron's existing review form, and the remaining setup questions. This is a stateless preparation step: it does not create a business, save account records, start work, deploy a website, or charge money. The person signs in by email in Baron to review and continue. Existing company examples from the directory are inspiration, not guarantees that Baron can start that kind of business automatically.

customer.description: Who the proposed business serves, such as independent bakeries.

delivery.description: How customers receive the result, such as a one-page website delivered online.

name.description: The business name, if the person has chosen one.

offering.description: The specific result or product customers would pay for.

name: prepare_business_brief
title: Prepare an AI business brief
